n6929020bda.headline: US, China ratify Paris climate deal, setting stage for G20
n6929020bda.summary: China and the United States ratified the Paris Agreement to cut climate-warming emissions, marking a major step toward its enactment by year-end.
n6929020bda.why: As the world's two largest economies and emitters, their ratification is crucial for global climate policy and may influence energy and regulatory markets.
n6929020bda.why_moved: Ratification by the US and China, the largest emitters, increases confidence in global climate policy, affecting energy sectors and regulatory outlooks.
